# Offline data fixture provenance

These fixtures support the default test suite without reading the ignored `data/raw` or `data/normalized` trees. Companyfacts records and filing text are public SEC material. Generated fixture bytes are intentionally trimmed; test-only manifest copies pin the hashes of the trimmed companyfacts bodies while retaining the repository's accession metadata.

| Fixture | Size | Source and provenance |
|---|---:|---|
| `companyfacts/aapl_offline_subset.json` | 8,775 bytes | Trimmed from the AAPL companyfacts payload for pinned accession `0000320193-25-000079`; source URL `https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK0000320193.json`; full source SHA-256 `73a86c6aedc31f77cac2ea4df5f80f0b3bd7e6eb58bb4e01444fbedf3afb9c43` from `data/manifests/filings.v1.json`. Retains the standard tags and annual periods needed by generated numeric eval cross-checks. |
| `companyfacts/msft_offline_subset.json` | 8,831 bytes | Trimmed from the MSFT companyfacts payload for pinned accession `0001193125-26-323660`; source URL `https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK0000789019.json`; full source SHA-256 `f8aae2965b20ad0df44bdf7ccbedf797d275b6b8dc030154a7a311361bb7246f` from the filing manifest. Retains the standard tags and annual periods needed by generated numeric eval cross-checks. |
| `normalized/msft_financial_statements_excerpt.txt` | 1,200 bytes | Exact text excerpt beginning at the Financial Statements section offset of pinned MSFT accession `0001193125-26-323660`, filing URL `https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000119312526323660/msft-20260630.htm`. The fixture SHA-256 is `b989eed0f537f67a1efe7ed237a2c3b6fb2bb017351d9b048672ce9d9404dc52`; the source canonical-text SHA-256 is `ae62ceff4d5eb49b8f8ef3e04dde60aa70784f07df2f697704d3b8fcbb86c1e1`. Tests derive matching section metadata in a temporary directory and still assert pagination and corruption detection. |
| `eval/gold_chunks/*/chunks.jsonl` | 588 bytes combined | Retains only gold `evidence_id` and `accession_number` pairs needed to validate the frozen eval set. Rows are extracted from the built chunk manifests for AAPL accession `0000320193-25-000079` (source file SHA-256 `a0b7bfd8f5d8b606c00a5d34b645646432a1e4d0df57de80e9d129ffe2eb6d48`) and MSFT accession `0001193125-26-323660` (source file SHA-256 `3f169be0c92c79e61a230649aab90381379fdd207038fc7ddd28911d0f139b13`); each accession's filing URL is recorded in `data/manifests/filings.v1.json`. Text bodies are unnecessary for the dataset validator. |

The SEC companyfacts and filing URLs above are the source artifacts; test code does not fetch them. Fixture-specific hashes are computed from the committed fixture bytes where the calculator verifies snapshot identity. No test reads a local SEC cache as a fallback.
